The reference formulas for AdaptiveLogSoftmaxWithLoss are: tail_logits = (x @ tail0^T) @ (tail1^T / div_value) and head_logits are computed on the head weight only. The current tail kernel computes log_softmax(x @ tail0^T @ tail1^T), omitting the division by div_value=2.0. This omission reduces the tail logits by exactly log(2.0), causing every tail value (indices >= 5000) to be too high by ~0.693, matching the observed errors and the 50% mismatch pattern (only tail region wrong). Because the head part is correct and tail logits are wrong, the fix is to divide the tail logits by div_value before computing log_softmax in the tail path, or equivalently subtract log(div_value) after log_softmax.
